title: Create character request
description: Body of POST /characters (scope characters.manage). The Scribe starts on the start Anchor of map, with sets or the starting loadout. Refused with character.invalid_name, character.name_taken, character.too_many, set.obsolete or a set reason key.

sets.description: Optional. The gear sets the Scribe prepares; the first one is active. Defaults to the starting loadout.

map.description: Optional. The map where the Scribe starts. Defaults to the starting map.
